title: feat: add support for clicking tilde paths
body:
Previously, only relative (`../.bashrc`) and absolute (`/Users/so-and-so/.bashrc`) paths were clickable. This PR changes the regex to match tilde-prefixed paths and adds shell-style tilde expansion before opening the paths.

AI Disclosure: I used Opus to assist me with the Zig side of things. I've reviewed it thoroughly by hand and tested it manually.

Related to #1972.
